centralised.passes_when: There is a reserve report 120 days old or less.
The report names an outside firm and compares holdings with what customers are owed.
A customer can check their own balance, or a wallet list is published.
The EU register has a row for the company and it is not on the EU warning list.
Every customer loss in the last 5 years is marked repaid in full.

swap.passes_when: The first trade is 12 months old or more.
Every user loss in the last 24 months is marked repaid in full.
The contracts holding user money cannot be changed, or every change waits 7 days or more.
A change needs more than one signer.
The newest audit is 18 months old or less, or the contracts cannot be changed at all.
A user can withdraw without the operator.

leveraged.passes_when: The first trade is 12 months old or more.
Every user loss in the last 24 months is marked repaid in full.
The contracts holding user money cannot be changed, or every change waits 7 days or more.
A change needs more than one signer.
The newest audit is 18 months old or less, or the contracts cannot be changed at all.
A user can withdraw without the operator.
No forced closure of winning traders is on record in the last 12 months.
Trades, liquidations and the backstop balance are publicly readable.

reserve_report_points.passes_when: The report is 120 days old or less.
It compares holdings with what customers are owed.
A customer can check that their own balance is included.

order_rule.centralised: Ordered by checks passed (out of six). A tie is broken by the reserve report detail (out of five). A tie after that is broken A to Z. Paying changes nothing.
order_rule.swap: Ordered by checks passed (out of six). A tie is broken A to Z. Paying changes nothing.
order_rule.leveraged: Ordered by checks passed (out of eight). A tie is broken A to Z. Paying changes nothing.

text.ranked_when: A row is ranked once a person has confirmed every one of its checks against the source. Until then it is listed as being checked.
rules: Not published never counts as a pass.
A sponsor tag never moves a row. A sponsor that fails a check fails it in public.
Every threshold is our choice. A change is announced 30 days ahead and applies to every row on the same day.

fact_statuses.could_not_open: the source could not be opened
fact_statuses.being_checked: a person has not confirmed it yet
fact_statuses.needs_primary_source: it waits for a source from the exchange or a regulator
fact_statuses.unknown: a status these tools do not know

check_states.confirmed: a person has confirmed the fact against its source
check_states.being_checked: a person has not confirmed it yet, so no value is published
check_states.needs_primary_source: it waits for a source from the exchange or a regulator

fact_words.reserve_report_date: the date of the newest reserve report
fact_words.reserve_report_url: the link to the newest reserve report
fact_words.reserve_outside_firm: whether the reserve report names an outside firm
fact_words.reserve_compares_liabilities: whether the reserve report compares holdings with what customers are owed
fact_words.reserve_self_check: whether a customer can check that their own balance is included
fact_words.reserve_wallet_list: whether a wallet list is published
fact_words.protection_fund_stated: the protection fund the exchange states
fact_words.eu_entity_name: the company named for customers in the EU
fact_words.eu_authorisation_claim: what the exchange says about its EU authorisation
fact_words.contract_company_eea: the company named in the user terms for an EEA country
fact_words.simple_buy_fee: the fee stated for the simple buy screen
fact_words.btc_withdrawal_fee: the fee stated for a bitcoin withdrawal
fact_words.audited_accounts: whether the company publishes audited accounts
fact_words.data_terms_clause: whether outsiders may publish statistics from its market data
fact_words.first_trade_date: the date of the first trade
fact_words.contracts_changeable: whether the contracts holding user money can be changed
fact_words.change_delay_days: how long a change must wait
fact_words.change_signers_required: how many signers a change needs
fact_words.last_audit_date: the date of the newest audit
fact_words.last_audit_firm: the firm behind the newest audit
fact_words.withdraw_without_operator: whether a user can withdraw without the operator
fact_words.withdrawals_ever_paused: whether withdrawing has ever been paused
fact_words.backstop_balance_public: whether the backstop balance is publicly readable
